item.title: University of Toronto Antenna Measurement Workshop — Fri Oct 16 — Bahen Centre for Information Technology
item.description: Join us for a full-day, in-person workshop on antenna measurements, bringing together students, young professionals, researchers, and industry professionals for a combination of expert lectures and live demonstrations. The workshop will feature Prof. Yahya Rahmat-Samii, Distinguished Professor at UCLA, and Dr. Vincent Rodriguez, Staff Electromagnetic Engineer at NSI-MI Technologies and Chair of the IEEE AP-S Technical Committee on Antenna Measurements. Sessions will cover antenna theory fundamentals, practical measurement considerations, and key antenna measurement standards. Participants will also have the opportunity to attend live near-field and far-field antenna measurement demonstrations in anechoic chambers at the University of Toronto, providing a practical look at measurement setups, procedures, and techniques. item.title: Absolute Beginner Hand-Sewing Workshop — Sat Oct 24, 1:00 PM — HackLab.TO 1677 St Clair Ave W
item.description:
Do you want to know how to sew your own clothes? Do you know absolutely nothing about sewing clothes? Barbie and I can help! There's a lot more that goes into making clothes than poking a string through some cloth. This is a workshop for people who want to sew but have no idea how to get started. Everyone who attends will design a piece of clothing, make the pattern, prepare the fabric, cut the pieces, and hand-stitch it together in a 3-hour period. The catch is that it won't be for you, it'll be for Barbie. Don't worry though! Once you've seen the process through and learned each step, the skills can be scaled up to whatever dimensions your real body has. Barbie is a convenient model because she's just shy of twelve inches tall, but the process is exactly the same for humans too.
Source: HackLab.TO
